key_insights: Weekly market structure for BTC showing weakness with first lower low since ETF week
Massive altcoin open interest wipeout (1920B to 11B) - mega-wipeouts tend to lead to trend reversal not continuation
Post-liquidation market flow is difficult to trade - mechanical bounce trade is complete, next trade less clear
Funding rates must be interpreted in context of price action - negative funding during liquidations doesn't necessarily mean new short positioning
Don't just trade levels blindly - after multiple tests, wait for breakdown and reclaim rather than buying support directly
summary: BTC showing weekly market structure weakness with lower lows at 67, trading in 61.1-62.5 support zone for third test. Altcoins experienced massive open interest wipeout from 1920B to 11B, signaling potential trend reversal. ETH struggling around 3k with support at 2.9-3k but not attractive due to proximity to resistance. Speaker advising caution post-liquidation as mechanical bounce trades are complete and market flow is difficult to trade.
